reviewItem.question: Does "Ignoring all status updates and high churn mutations: Argo CD manifest now contains a default configuration for `resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates`…" mean a change to config-key:argo-cd|path=resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates|component=argocd-cm (added)?

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 adds a default configuration for resource.customizations.ignoreResourceUpdates in the argocd-cm ConfigMap that excludes common mutated resources and always ignores .status changes; the v2 behavior can be preserved by overriding or removing this configuration.
